panel.valid_call_rule: error is None and label_assigned is one of L1..L6; no retries or raw-response reparsing

entropy_definitions.vote_entropy: Shannon entropy -sum p*log2(p) of labels across all valid raw calls in each pair; bits, not normalized. Calls carry equal weight; missing calls reduce a judge's contribution.
entropy_definitions.first_yes_entropy: Same raw-valid-call calculation for first_yes_question; empty first-YES fields excluded; bits, not normalized. Separate from modal reliability.
entropy_definitions.judge_modal_entropy_bits: Sensitivity: Shannon entropy of one untied modal label per available judge (equal judge weight). Missing and tied judge modes excluded; denominator 3 for 93 pairs and 2 for 3 pairs. Bits, not divided by log2(3).

panel.aggregation_rule: Unique per-judge modal across valid replicates; tied modes excluded. Across retained judge modals use unique mode; >=2 tied judges or tied across-judge modes produce TIE. Matches archived rule, checked against stored aggregation only after reconstruction.

reliability.unit: pair; nominal L1-L6; one untied modal label per judge

bootstrap.method: Unstratified pair bootstrap; resample all panel pairs with replacement, retain all judge modals for each selected pair; percentile 95% CI. Fleiss uses complete-judge pairs within each draw; alpha uses pairable pairs.
bootstrap.limitation: Describes variation across this designed pair collection; does not resample judges or establish external population validity.

legacy_lexicographic_tiebreak_sensitivit.role: Comparison reconstructed from raw calls; not the primary tie policy
legacy_lexicographic_tiebreak_sensitivit.cause: analyze_results.py assigns winners[0] to tied within-judge modes; run_label_panel.py excludes those modes. Primary analysis follows the latter consistently.

systems.aggregation: One unique modal prediction per pair (S6: three calls; S2/S5: one calibrated frozen score). Panel ties excluded. Unresolved system modes reported explicitly and excluded from evaluable denominator; failure-counting sensitivity supplied.

S2_wulff_mata.method: Archived common.py rule: upper order-statistic median (including even n), margin 0.03, fitted on designed D control labels before panel scoring. No tuning in this reanalysis.

S5_generic_embed.method: Archived common.py rule: upper order-statistic median (including even n), margin 0.03, fitted on designed D control labels before panel scoring. No tuning in this reanalysis.

systems.limitations: S2 and S5 use BGE-M3 frozen approximations, not independent model families. Their archived scalar mapping cannot emit L3 or L6. D controls calibrate thresholds and are reused in the ALL score; NONCONTROLS is reported separately. Panel agreement is not validated accuracy. No raw outputs for S1/S3/S4 are in this bounded input set.

Q6.method: Exact two-sided matched-pair McNemar, S6 vs S2 and S6 vs S5, restricted to reconstructed panel L3; one modal prediction per pair. Holm over exactly two tests: cumulative maximum of sorted (m-rank)*p, capped at 1.
Q6.limitation: The two scalar baselines cannot emit L3 under the archived mapping. A significant difference therefore includes a structural output-space advantage; it does not isolate hierarchy reasoning.

Q7.method: Difference in mean per-pair Shannon first-YES entropy (A_prime minus comparator), in bits. Randomly assign the A_prime membership across whole pairs at its fixed size, equivalent for this statistic to shuffling all category labels preserving category sizes. Monte Carlo p=(exceedances+1)/(B+1); exact enumeration used only if all allocations fit the budget.
Q7.primary_direction: A_prime has GREATER entropy than all non-A_prime pairs (one-sided upper tail).
Q7.sensitivity: Remove D calibration/control pairs: A_prime vs A+B+C. Raw label-vote entropy repeats the calculation as a measurement sensitivity. judge_modal_entropy_bits uses one available untied modal label per judge to remove replicate weighting. Lower-tail and absolute two-sided p-values are exploratory, not the pre-stated directional Q7.
Q7.limitation: Permutation reference assumes exchangeable pair category assignments; these categories are designed, not randomized. Resample entire pairs, never individual calls. No block by construct identity is available in this analysis, so reused constructs may violate pair independence. Failure of the greater-entropy prediction is not an equivalence test or proof of stability.

leave_one_judge_out.rule: Omit one judge, retain each other judge's raw-replicate modal; two usable remaining judges must agree. Disagreement is TIE; fewer than two usable judges is INSUFFICIENT. No arbitrary tie break.

S1_origin_counts.interpretation: No definition_backfill record is an absence-of-metadata category, not proof of original cited text or human validation. Grounding/confidence are archived metadata, not independently verified here.

risk.interpretation: Historical HIGH/MED/LOW and gold_tier flags are reproduced as sampling heuristics, not validated quality or correctness. Weakest definition_source string governs source_strength; a weak side does not imply both sides have no source. No source lookup or human validation was conducted.

old_Q6.null_hypothesis: S6 correctness on L3 pairs equals S2 and equals S5
old_Q6.test: two McNemar tests with Holm correction
old_Q6.power_note: McNemar needs ≥ ~10 discordant pairs for stable inference; smaller L3 subsets yield wide CIs.

old_Q7.test: permutation null over category labels (1000 iterations)
old_Q7.power_note: Permutation preserves category sizes; power depends on raw between-category entropy gap and pair count per category.
